results.scenario: 500 simultaneous SSE connections held for 5 seconds

limitations: This is a single-machine, read-only test and is not a production capacity certification.
The development database has 50 users and does not represent production data volume.
Write-heavy timer, reward, video, notification, and cron traffic was intentionally excluded to avoid modifying data.
The production VPS CPU, RAM, network, disk IOPS, Postgres settings, and CDN behavior were not reproduced.
